## Summary / Title

> A brief, clear overview of the change.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Infra
- [ ] Other

## Related Issues

> Link related tickets or issues. Use keywords like `Closes #123` to automate closing.

## Context & Motivation

> Explain why this change is happening, not just what changed.

## How to Verify (Testing)

> Step-by-step instructions or test cases for the reviewer.

## Screenshots / GIFs

> If this is a UI change, add visual evidence here.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Documentation updated if needed
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Changes are ready to merge
